caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden hand plane, placed against a plain light beige background. The plane is rendered in shades of brown, with visible wood grain texture throughout the entire surface, indicating the material. The body of the plane is rectangular with softly rounded edges, and it includes a prominent handle with a curved, open grip on the right side. On the upper part of the body, there is a slanted wedge and blade assembly, both also illustrated in brown hues with wood grain details. The drawing uses shading to suggest light coming from the upper left, producing subtle shadows on the tool. There are no other objects or decorations present, and the composition is centered on the page.
title: Plane
